skill.name: klaviyo-automation
skill.description: Automate Klaviyo campaign discovery, message inspection, tag lookup, and send-job monitoring through Rube MCP and Composio.
skill.summary: Inspect and monitor Klaviyo campaigns through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All static external command detections are Markdown inline code or code fences, not executable shell or Ruby code. The hardcoded URL is the expected Rube MCP endpoint, and the blocker detections are table entries for Klaviyo tasks. No prompt injection or malicious intent evidence was found.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Klaviyo connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `klaviyo`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. Call `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `klaviyo`
1. `KLAVIYO_GET_CAMPAIGNS` - List campaigns with channel and status filters [Required]
- `channel`: Campaign channel - 'email' or 'sms' (required by Klaviyo API)
- `filter`: Additional filter string (e.g., `equals(status,"draft")`)
- `sort`: Sort field with optional `-` prefix for descending (e.g., '-created_at', 'name')
- `page_cursor`: Pagination cursor for next page
- `include_archived`: Include archived campaigns (default: false)
- `channel` is required; omitting it can produce incomplete or unexpected results
- Follow `page_cursor` until exhausted to get all campaigns
- Status filtering via `filter` (e.g., `equals(status,"draft")`) can return mixed statuses; always v
- Response shape is nested: `response.data.data` with status at `data[].attributes.status`
1. `KLAVIYO_GET_CAMPAIGNS` - Find campaign to get its ID [Prerequisite]
2. `KLAVIYO_GET_CAMPAIGN` - Retrieve full campaign details [Required]
- `campaign_id`: Campaign ID string (e.g., '01GDDKASAP8TKDDA2GRZDSVP4H')
- `include_messages`: Include campaign messages in response
- `include_tags`: Include tags in response
- `include_messages` and `include_tags` add related data to the response via Klaviyo's include mecha
1. `KLAVIYO_GET_CAMPAIGN` - Find campaign and its message IDs [Prerequisite]
2. `KLAVIYO_GET_CAMPAIGN_MESSAGE` - Get message content details [Required]
- `id`: Message ID string
- `fields__campaign__message`: Sparse fieldset for message attributes (e.g., 'content.subject', 'con
- `fields__campaign`: Sparse fieldset for campaign attributes
- `fields__template`: Sparse fieldset for template attributes
- `include`: Related resources to include ('campaign', 'template')
1. `KLAVIYO_GET_CAMPAIGN_RELATIONSHIPS_TAGS` - Get tag IDs for a campaign [Required]
- `id`: Campaign ID string
1. `KLAVIYO_GET_CAMPAIGN_SEND_JOB` - Check send job status [Required]
- `id`: Send job ID
- Check response for `page_cursor` in the pagination metadata
- Pass cursor as `page_cursor` in next request
- Data is nested: `response.data.data[].attributes`
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
| Get campaign tags | KLAVIYO_GET_CAMPAIGN_RELATIONSHIPS_TAGS | id |
| Get send job status | KLAVIYO_GET_CAMPAIGN_SEND_JOB | id |

content.value_statement: Klaviyo campaign reviews can be slow when teams need IDs, message fields, tags, and send status across pages. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows that collect those details consistently.
actual_capabilities: Searches Rube MCP tool schemas before Klaviyo workflows.
Guides Klaviyo connection setup through RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS.
Lists and filters Klaviyo campaigns by channel, status, sort, and cursor.
Retrieves campaign details with related messages and tags.
Inspects campaign message subject, sender, reply-to, body, and template fields.
Checks Klaviyo campaign send job status.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Klaviyo connection.
Depends on current Composio and Klaviyo tool schemas.
Focuses on campaign inspection and monitoring, not full account administration.
Must follow Klaviyo rate limits and permission boundaries.

use_cases.title: Campaign Operations Review
use_cases.description: Marketing operators can list campaigns, filter by status, and collect details before a send review.

use_cases.title: Message Content Inspection
use_cases.description: Email teams can inspect subjects, sender fields, and template content without navigating the Klaviyo UI.

use_cases.title: Send Status Monitoring
use_cases.description: Support teams can check campaign send jobs and explain whether delivery is queued, complete, or failed.

prompt_templates.title: List Email Campaigns
prompt_templates.prompt: Use klaviyo-automation to list email campaigns. Search tools first, then show campaign names, IDs, statuses, and any next-page cursor.

prompt_templates.title: Find Draft Campaigns
prompt_templates.prompt: Find draft email campaigns named Newsletter. Use the correct channel, paginate if needed, and confirm each returned status client-side.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Campaign Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this campaign ID, retrieve campaign details and message content. Summarize subject, preview text, sender, reply-to, and template availability.

prompt_templates.title: Review Launch Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this campaign before launch. Collect details, related message fields, tag IDs, and send job status if a job ID is provided.

output: Found three draft email campaigns after two pages.
Each result includes name, campaign ID, status, created date, and pagination notes.
One campaign returned a mixed server-side status, so it was excluded after client-side validation.

output_examples.output: The response summarizes campaign status, send strategy, audience notes, subject, preview text, sender fields, and available template content.
The response states whether the job is queued, in progress, complete, or failed, with any API rate-limit guidance.

best_practices: Search Rube tools before every workflow so schemas match the current Composio integration.
Confirm Klaviyo connection status is ACTIVE before requesting campaign data.
Paginate until no cursor remains, then validate campaign statuses client-side.
anti_patterns: Do not assume one page contains every campaign.
Do not rely only on server-side status filters for final decisions.
Do not request message content unless the user has permission to view it.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires Rube MCP and an active Klaviyo connection through Composio.

faq.question: Can it send campaigns?
faq.answer: The documented workflows focus on listing, inspecting, tagging relationships, and send-job status checks.

faq.question: Does it need Klaviyo API keys?
faq.answer: The setup uses Rube MCP authentication, not direct API key entry in the skill.

faq.question: Which channels are supported?
faq.answer: The campaign listing workflow supports email and SMS channels when the Klaviyo tool schema allows them.

faq.question: How does it handle pagination?
faq.answer: It follows Klaviyo page cursors until no next cursor remains.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with private campaigns?
faq.answer: Use it only with authorized accounts because it can retrieve campaign details and message content.
